value.rationale: An exact first/second equilibrium-count law is a natural quantitative invariant for random heterogeneous network games and supplies a rare exact finite-graph statistical-mechanics benchmark. The two-replica spectrum yields a genuinely nontrivial exponential relative-variance rate (5+sqrt(17))/9 > 1 despite near-sure existence, distinguishing existence testing from equilibrium-count concentration. The full n-dependent parity corrections are mathematically structural, not arbitrary finite tables.
